entry.title: GAZOO Racing and Lexus thrill crowds at the Goodwood Festival of Speed
entry.content: GAZOO Racing gave a thrilling taste of its sports car engineering with high-speed demonstrations by the upcoming GR GT and GR GT3* at the Goodwood Festival of Speed at the weekend. They were joined by the Lexus LFA Concept*, which delighted the crowds with a surprise appearance on the festival’s hill climb – its dynamic world premiere. entry.title: Toyota, BMW, Bosch and Repsol launch a real-world pilot of vehicles running on 100% renewable gasoline
entry.content: Brussels, 15 July 2026 – Toyota Motor Europe (TME), in collaboration with BMW Group, Bosch and Repsol, today announces the launch of a pioneering six-month pilot project in Spain. The pilot, which started in early July, will demonstrate the real-world potential of Vehicles running Exclusively on Eligible Fuels (VEEF)*.
